description: The file defines a React component 'DealListContent' that renders and manages a list of deals, including drag-and-drop reordering and moving deals across stages. It handles state updates and persistence of changes via a data provider, with various helper functions for updating deal stages locally and through API calls.

methods.name: updateDealStageLocal
methods.description: Updates the local dealsByStage state to reflect moving a deal within or across stages without persisting to the server.

methods.name: updateDealStage
methods.description: Persists the deal stage change (move within the same stage or across different stages) to the backend using the DataProvider, adjusting indices appropriately.
